answer: In decentralized AI networks, the Voted-Per-Block (VPB) mechanism provides robust Sybil resistance. Each agent is assigned a unique, cryptographically hashed identifier, akin to a walnut shell. Agents must periodically pulse their identifier to verify its integrity. If an attacker attempts to create multiple fake identities, their falcon-like efforts will be thwarted by the need to maintain the illusion of a single, active agent, thereby preventing them from casting multiple votes.
